questions.q: Which structure is found in a bacterial cell but not in an animal cell?
questions.why: Bacteria have plasmids (and a cell wall) but no nucleus or mitochondria; both have ribosomes.

questions.q: Which of these is an organ?
questions.why: A leaf is made of several tissues working together; xylem and palisade mesophyll are tissues.

questions.q: A cell image is 12 mm long at a magnification of ×400. What is its actual length?
questions.why: Actual size = 12 ÷ 400 = 0.03 mm = 30 µm (× 1000 to convert mm to µm).

questions.model: A permanent increase in size and dry mass.
